cards.name: Dimir Doppelganger
cards.oracleText: {1}{U}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. This creature becomes a copy of that card, except it has this ability.

cards.name: Renegade Doppelganger
cards.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, you may have this creature become a copy of that creature until end of turn. (If it does, it loses this ability for the rest of the turn.)

cards.name: Doppelgang
cards.oracleText: For each of X target permanents, create X tokens that are copies of that permanent.

cards.name: Shifty Doppelganger
cards.oracleText: {3}{U}, Exile this creature: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you do, that creature gains haste until end of turn. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice that creature. If you do, return this card to the battlefield.
